name: rundrill-js
description: JavaScript & TypeScript coach — learn to read, trace, and review code (incl. AI-generated), with drills, progress, and mistake memory, inside your AI agent.

interface.shortDescription: JS/TS coach: read, trace, and review code with drills and progress.
interface.longDescription: An interactive JavaScript & TypeScript coach for the AI era: predict-and-trace drills, fix-the-bug, and a signature 'review the AI's code' drill that teaches you to catch the bug an AI left behind — coercion, this/closures, async ordering, over-used any/as in TS. Backed by the RunDrill MCP engine with progress tracking and mistake memory. Core language spine plus Frontend, Backend/Node, and Engine-Internals tracks.
defaultPrompt: Review some AI-written JS and let me find the bug.
